messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT PAGE - high p99 latency detected for /v1/generate across us-west-2. Trigger: p99 > 1200ms for 3m. Pager: ashwin. Severity: P1

ashwin: seeing huge p99 spike, p95 also climbing. dashboards show streaming stalls in router->lb path. paging SRE. stack traces look like long tail in router write queue.

sylvie: jumping in, linking traces. looks like routing_policy service returned skewed weights to lb-controller at ~12:06 UTC. some shards got 4x traffic.

maria: confirming — weight dump: `curl http://routing-policy/internal/weights` shows repeated high weight to shard-09 in us-west-2. possible regression from yesterday's rollout.

ashwin: impact snapshot: 12:04-12:10 UTC, p95=350ms (baseline 120ms), p99=1500ms (baseline 300ms). error rate unchanged. streaming stalls up from 0.3% -> 3.4%. ~18% of requests hit >1s streaming stall.

sylvie: are any customers impacted with active long polling? Ops console shows a handful of enterprise customers with active sessions in usw2: acme-inc, vectra-ai, beaconlabs.

robin-oncall: assigning myself to coordination. ashwin you're primary. sylvie lead triage on routing policy. maria help with LB metrics and dump. I'll do customer comms triage.

ashwin: quick mitigation idea: instruct lb-controller to apply per-shard caps and revert weights to config. can we push `weight_overrides: null`?

maria: we can PATCH the controller. here's the command I'm going to run after review:
```
curl -X PATCH https://lb-controller.usw2.internal/overrides \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"shard_overrides":[], "normalize":true }'
```

ashwin: +1, that should clear the leak. prepping to run with sylvie.

sylvie: before we change, snapshot routing-policy version: `git rev-parse --short HEAD` -> `a4f9c2e`. Rolling back that rollout could be next.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: routing-policy v1.8.3 -> v1.9.0 rolled out at 2026-03-14T11:59:02Z to us-west-2 (30% canary).

maria: applying override now. will monitor.

maria: PATCH done. lb-controller returned 200. overrides cleared.

ashwin: watching metrics... p99 dropping from 1500ms -> 620ms in 30s. p95 -> 180ms. streaming stalls down to 0.9%.

sylvie: good. routing-policy still reporting odd feedback loop. I'm rolling the canary back to v1.8.3 entirely for usw2.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: routing-policy rollback to v1.8.3 initiated for us-west-2.

maria: rollback completed on all nodes in usw2. verifying traffic distribution.

maria: distribution now even across shards, no single shard > 2.5x average. p99 at 310ms, steady.

ashwin: logs show earlier bug: a divide-by-zero in weight normalization when a rarely-seen route had zero capacity. created `weight = weight / (sum || 1)` fix needed.

sylvie: filing PR for fix with unit test covering zero-sum edge. tagging triage label. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing-policy/pull/897

robin-oncall: customer impact notes for postmortem: 6m window with elevated tail. Affected region: us-west-2. Estimated affected requests: 26k. Major customers with incidental latency: acme-inc, vectra-ai, beaconlabs (ops will follow up). No request errors, just latency.

ashwin: marking incident resolved for now. will keep monitoring for 30m.

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE - Status changed to RESOLVED by ashwin at 12:18:32 UTC.

maria: follow-ups: 1) backfill canary gating to detect weight drift earlier; 2) add synthetic test for zero-sum weights; 3) alert tuning — add a secondary check on per-shard QPS skew > 3x baseline.

sylvie: adding a runbook step: if p99 > 1s and per-shard skew present, run `PATCH /overrides` and rollback routing-policy canary.

robin-oncall: I'll draft an incident summary for SLT and coordinate customer comms with CS. tagging rca owners: sylvie (code fix), maria (alerts), ashwin (postmortem).

ashwin: thanks all. leaving monitoring watch for 20m. ping me if any regression. :thumbsup:
